heading: Friday, May 16, 2025
topLine: OpenAI introduces Codex cloud agent powered by codex-1.

items.headline: OpenAI introduces Codex cloud agent powered by codex-1
items.summary: codex-1 is a version of o3 tuned for software engineering with reinforcement learning on real coding tasks; it powers Codex, a cloud agent that runs multiple coding tasks in parallel. A smaller o4-mini-based variant shipped as codex-mini-latest for Codex CLI.
